hypothesis: A runtime-oriented fixed-half-support ternary representation generalized to every even Qwen tensor tail, plus conservative per-tensor learned-route and ratio-128 INT4 correction storage, can project the complete pinned Qwen3.8-27B checkpoint at or below 1.58 bits per total parameter after independently aligning every component and counting exact retained tensors metadata tokenizer configuration and auxiliary model files

scope.claim_boundary: authenticated byte-accounting projection only; not an exported artifact, real-weight quality, capability, token-throughput, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

representation.full_group: 128 support bits plus 64 support-ordered sign bits for exactly 64 nonzeros
representation.even_tail: n support bits plus n/2 support-ordered sign bits for exactly n/2 nonzeros
representation.raw_mask_rate: exactly 1.5 bits per compressed parameter for observed widths
representation.scale_metadata: packed 4-bit group indices one FP16 row anchor and one 16-entry FP16 ratio codebook per tensor
representation.correction: one signed INT4 coefficient per output-row/sketch coordinate plus one FP16 row scale
representation.learned_route: one bitpacked bucket and sign per input coordinate counted independently per tensor
representation.retained_policy: rank-one and flattened input widths below 128 remain exact in source dtype
representation.alignment: every code scale correction route header and retained section independently aligned to 64 bytes
representation.auxiliary: every non-safetensors file in the pinned model directory counted byte-for-byte

promotion_rules: the real safetensors headers and pinned download receipt must authenticate all tensor shapes dtypes and the complete denominator
no gate/up or attention-route sharing savings may be assumed
all short convolution and rank-one tensors must remain exact and be counted
all tokenizer config license index and other auxiliary model files must be counted
a pass establishes byte feasibility only and does not establish that tail codecs or kernels exist
a pass does not establish that fixed-half-support plus learned correction preserves real weights or capability
artifact export kernel integration CUTE MMLU-style MATH-500 WikiText and code gates remain mandatory
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
Qwen 4B compute is forbidden in this research lane
this ledger cannot by itself establish semi-lossless compression or a scientific breakthrough
